In any case, by the time these women came to me for help, they had already searched their souls and made up their minds. This was not some abstract cause far away—-these were real people in real distress--and | just couldn't say no. For nearly a decade, that became my fetal yoga. And, in

the process, | had evolved from a satirist into an activist.
